title: Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?
abstract: arXiv:2610.21459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) receive image-generation supervision that exposes them to visual information not fully documented in text. Can learning to generate images expand what pretrained models know? We introduce Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP), a controlled protocol that supplies new knowledge through image-generation training and tests its accessibility through text-only question answering. Across seven knowledge categories and three UMMs, we observe direct but uneven transfer from visual supervision to language. Motivated by these observations, we successively introduce Textual Alignment and Interleaved Image--Text Alignment, which connect generation and answering through shared knowledge and interleaved responses, respectively. translated_title: 视觉生成能否扩展统一多模态模型所掌握的知识？
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）接受图像生成监督训练，这使其接触到文本中未完全记录的视觉信息。那么，学习生成图像能否扩展预训练模型所掌握的知识？我们提出了知识转移探测，这是一种受控协议，通过图像生成训练注入新知识，并通过纯文本问答来测试这些知识的可访问性。在七个知识类别和三个统一多模态模型上的实验中，我们观察到从视觉监督到语言存在直接但不均匀的知识转移。基于这些观察，我们相继提出了文本对齐和交错图文对齐方法，分别通过共享知识和交错响应将生成与回答联系起来。对选定实体的引导可以在无需问答监督的情况下提升模型对其他实体的知识访问能力，而交错对齐则带来了额外的增益。进一步的分析表明，知识能够正确……
tldr: 本文提出知识转移探测（KTP）协议，首次证明图像生成训练能使统一多模态模型将视觉监督中的新知识迁移到语言问答能力中，并通过文本对齐与交错图文对齐方法显著增强这种跨模态知识转移效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP), demonstrating for the first time that image-generation training enables unified multimodal models to transfer new knowledge from visual supervision into language question answering, with Textual Alignment and Interleaved Image-Text Alignment further enhancing this cross-modal knowledge transfer.
